correctness.rationale: Using S3≅Z3⋊Z2 and its four assignments of flip parities, the evaluated translation and parity are exactly determined by Φ(w)=(number of 0 mod 6, A(w), B(w), C(w)) with sign-accumulator sums modulo 3. Specific assignments recover each coordinate, so Φ is necessary and sufficient for all 36 permutation evaluations. Append 0/1 gives the explicitly stated recurrence on 6×3×3×3=162 states. Independent recurrence enumerated all lengths n=1..18 and exact all-36-assignment evaluation for every binary word through n=8, reproducing the table and all signatures at n=13,14,15,16,17,18. Each S3 element has sixth power identity, so appending 000000 preserves behavior and injects classes from n to n+6. Combined with the six full base lengths proves N3(n)=162 for every n≥13. No extrapolation from incomplete enumeration.
